description: Input questions used while developing the two agents (lessons are mined here). Only questions: no expected answers. 'topic' tells the Evaluator which reference fact to check (out_of_scope = no fact covers it); the Answering Agent never sees it.

items.question: When should a bus bridge be requested during a light-rail service suspension?
How late must a bus be before it is logged as a delay incident?
How soon must a maintenance ticket be opened for an infrastructure-issue incident?
What are the allowed incident categories?
When is an incident classified as Severity 1?
How long are incident records kept?
What is the best pizza place in San Jose?
What speed limit applies to light-rail trains during extreme heat?
Which fields are required when submitting a new incident report?
Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
